verdict.rationale: Pylon documents Background Agents that run asynchronous workflows and prepare investigations on incoming issues before staff arrive. Triggers support complex workflows and automations from templates or from scratch. Other autonomous jobs include scheduled AI Reports to Slack, a daily AI-summarized Salesforce sync, automatic follow-up task generation after calls, and automatic issue creation from Slack channels. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that background agents run reliably, and detailed docs on how background agents are configured, scheduled and triggered (the evidence is mostly one-line summaries).
